name: pps-bus-maps
description: Bus route mapping app that parses PDFs from Google Drive

scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm run build
